metadata.title: Zajac, Jones & Glazier (2000, 2003) J. Theor. Biol. & Bertet, Sulak & Lecuit (2004) Nature Anisotropic Differential Adhesion, Polarized T1 Junctional Intercalation & Convergent Extension Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Xenopus laevis (chordamesoderm Keller explant) & Drosophila melanogaster (germband extension epithelium)

sources.citation: Zajac M, Jones GL, Glazier JA (2003). Simulating convergent extension by way of anisotropic differential adhesion. Journal of Theoretical Biology 222(2):247-259.
Zajac M, Jones GL, Glazier JA (2000). Model of convergent extension in animal morphogenesis. Physical Review Letters 85(9):2022-2025.
Bertet C, Sulak L, Lecuit T (2004). Myosin-dependent junction remodelling controls planar cell intercalation and axis elongation. Nature 429(6992):667-671.
Wallingford JB, Rowning BA, Vogeli KM, Rothbacher U, Fraser SE, Harland RM (2000). Dishevelled controls cell polarity during Xenopus gastrulation. Nature 405(6782):81-85.

convergent_extension_axis_specimen.species: Xenopus laevis gastrula explant comparing isotropic animal cap cell (Panel a, a') vs mediolaterally polarized chordamesoderm cell undergoing convergent extension (Panel b, b', e)

governing_equations.section: Zajac, Jones & Glazier (2003) J. Theor. Biol. 222:247-259 Eqs. 1-8; Bertet, Sulak & Lecuit (2004) Nature 429:667-671 Figs. 1-4

anisotropic_differential_adhesion_and_ju.adhesion_energy_formula: J(theta) = J_0 - Delta_J * cos(2 * theta),  where theta is interface angle relative to mediolateral (ML, x) axis
anisotropic_differential_adhesion_and_ju.polarized_junction_tension_formula: Lambda(theta) = Lambda_0 - Delta_Lambda * cos(2 * theta),  so Lambda_vert(pi/2) = Lambda_0 + Delta_Lambda > Lambda_horiz(0) = Lambda_0 - Delta_Lambda
anisotropic_differential_adhesion_and_ju.t1_free_energy_drop: Delta_E_T1 = (Lambda_horiz - Lambda_vert) * l_0 = -2 * Delta_Lambda * l_0 < 0  for Delta_Lambda > 0, l_0 > 0
anisotropic_differential_adhesion_and_ju.description: Zajac et al. (2000, 2003) show that mediolaterally elongated cells (aspect ratio a/b > 1) exhibit anisotropic differential adhesion J(theta) = J_0 - Delta_J cos(2*theta), equivalent to Bertet et al. (2004) planar-polarized Myosin II enrichment on vertical/AP-facing junctions (theta = pi/2, Lambda_vert = Lambda_0 + Delta_Lambda) relative to horizontal/ML junctions (theta = 0, Lambda_horiz = Lambda_0 - Delta_Lambda).

irreversible_t1_quartet_transition_and_p.area_invariance: A_tissue(t) = L_AP(t) * L_ML(t) = L_{AP,0} * L_{ML,0} = A_0
irreversible_t1_quartet_transition_and_p.aspect_ratio_scaling: R_CE(t) = L_AP(t) / L_ML(t) = R_0 * exp(2 * dot_epsilon_T1 * t)
irreversible_t1_quartet_transition_and_p.description: Active contraction of vertical/ML-oriented type-1 junctions to a 4-way T1 vertex (length < l_T1) followed by irreversible Myosin II-dependent resolution into horizontal/AP-elongating type-3 junctions drives pure-shear tissue narrowing (convergence in ML) and elongation (extension in AP) at conserved 2D tissue area A_tissue = L_AP * L_ML.

zajac_bertet_experimental_regimes.section: Zajac, Jones & Glazier (2003) J. Theor. Biol. 222:247-259 Figs. 3-7; Bertet, Sulak & Lecuit (2004) Nature 429:667-671 Figs. 1-4; Wallingford et al. (2000) Nature 405:81-85

regimes.label: Wild-Type Polarized Mediolateral Intercalation (Delta_Lambda/Lambda_0 = 0.48, Intact Myosin II T1 Ratchet)
Moderate Adhesion Anisotropy / Partial Myosin II Activity (Delta_Lambda/Lambda_0 = 0.28)
Wnt/PCP Dishevelled (Xdd1 / Stbm) Polarity-Scrambled Mutant (Uncoordinated Orientation)
Myosin II (zip / sqh / Y-27632) Junction-Resolution Defective Mutant (Stalled 4-Way Vertices)
Isotropic Adhesion / bicoid;nanos;torso-like Null Negative Control (Delta_Lambda = 0, No T1 Intercalation)
